action_taken: No new modules were created to wire these gates. Per the V5 architecture rule, this is emitted as a bounded follow-up finding (NEW-209) rather than expanded into the current closures.
consequence: Every gate in the contract is declarative only. A gate existing in the YAML does not mean it is implemented, invoked, evidenced or fail-closed. This is the exact 'orphan gate' condition section 15 asks to identify.
headline_finding: PRODUCTION_MAP_QUALITY_CONTRACT.yaml has NO EXECUTING CONSUMER in the repository. A repository-wide search for the contract filename in .py/.ps1/.sh/.yml files returns nothing, and no Python module reads its profiles, required_gates or status vocabulary.
note_on_method: Implementation detection is by gate-id string presence in source and tests, which is a conservative heuristic: a gate implemented under a different name would be reported as NOT_FOUND. The authoritative fact is the absence of any executing consumer, which is exact.
